head: THE SAME ALARM.
scenes.say: Every morning, the same alarm. The same road to work. Selling my time, hour by hour.

head: SELLING MY HOURS
*TO SOMEONE ELSE*
scenes.say: For years I gave my days to a system that was never built for me.

head: SO AT NIGHT,
*I BUILT MY OWN.*
scenes.say: So at night, I started building my own.

head: EVERY LOSS.
*EVERY WIN.*
scenes.say: Every loss went into a notebook. Every win too. I compared them, line by line, until my mistakes became my teachers.

head: NO EUPHORIA.
*ONLY DISCIPLINE.*
scenes.say: Sleepless nights turned into a philosophy. No euphoria. No shortcuts. Only discipline.

head: RULES THAT
*PROTECT ME FROM ME*
scenes.say: Rule by rule, the system grew. Bots that never sleep. Rules that protect me from myself.

head: AND ONE DAY,
*I WALKED OUT.*
scenes.say: And one day, I simply walked out.

head: FREEDOM IS
*BUILT DAILY.*
scenes.say: Freedom isn't dropped into a ballot box once every few years. You build it, every single day. Until your money works for you, and you never sell your time again.
